title: Re-verify a persistence fix
prompt:
A previous verification found that on `main` the workspace density page shows `Density saved` after the save button is clicked, but the value is never written to storage, so it is lost after a reload. The branch `benchmark/change` claims to fix this. Re-verify the fix.

1. Confirm from the diff between `main` and `HEAD` that the save action now writes the value under the same storage key the page reads on load.
2. Write a Playwright test at `tests/e2e/density-persists-after-reload.spec.ts` that visits `/density`, changes the density input, clicks the save button, reloads the page, and expects the input to show the saved value. It must fail on `main` and pass on `HEAD`.
3. Write `qa-result.json` in the repository root with exactly these keys: `fixConfirmed` (boolean), `storageKey` (string), `changedFile` (repository-relative path).

Do not modify files under `src/`.

fixture.commitMessage: fix: write the saved workspace density to storage

successCriteria.description: The re-verification test exists at the requested path.
The re-verification test reloads the page.
The re-verification test uses the save control.
Product source under src/ is unchanged.
The structured answer confirms the fix.
The structured answer names the storage key.
The structured answer names the changed source file.
